source: docs/corpus/canonical_reference_map.md §Canonical glossary and semantic-shift atlas (imported from sanskritree)
model: LEMMA -> SENSE { tradition, period, sense, translation_policy, evidence, semantic_warning }
principle: Semantic consistency is the goal, not lexical uniformity. A lemma has different senses per tradition/period. Do NOT construct a single Tantric dictionary.

senses.sense: Family/lineage of Yoginīs or Mothers
senses.warning: historically important; do not erase with later metaphysical translations

senses.sense: Body; totality of power and phenomena
senses.translation_policy: use 'aggregate/body/complex' only where passage supports it
senses.warning: intentional expansion from lineage to body/totality

senses.sense: Mantric/cosmic body; structured aggregate (kulātmaka)
senses.translation_policy: retain Kula when technical system activated
senses.warning: avoid automatically translating 'family'

senses.sense: relational pole to akula/anuttara (metaphysical polarity)
senses.translation_policy: usually retain as Kula in technical contexts
senses.warning: interpret in relation to akula and kaulikī śakti

senses.sense: Order, succession, sequence, method
senses.warning: do not infer 'Krama school' from the noun alone

senses.sense: Ordered unfolding of cognition reflected in ordered worship (pūjākrama ↔ saṃvitkrama)
senses.warning: sequence is simultaneously ritual and phenomenological

senses.sense: Sequence, progressive manifestation, graduated procedure
senses.warning: sometimes generic; sometimes carries inherited Krama resonance

senses.sense: Power/dynamism constitutive of manifestation and cognition
senses.warning: not 'energy'

senses.sense: Goddess/mantric power with phonemic and triadic articulation
senses.warning: deity, language, causal power overlap

senses.sense: Freedom/power of consciousness; differentiated powers reintegrated into supreme awareness
senses.warning: a single English 'energy' is seriously impoverished

senses.sense: Dynamic pulse/activity of the fundamental conscious reality
senses.warning: 'vibration' risks sounding mechanically physical

senses.sense: Reflexive apprehension, self-awareness, consciousness's capacity to apprehend itself and its content
senses.warning: 'reflection' alone falsely implies discursive thought

senses.sense: reflexion-that-is-the-sequence (svātma-cit-krama-vimarśa)
senses.translation_policy: the reflexion that IS the sequence
senses.warning: the Krama reflexion is the saṃvit-krama's self-grasping

senses.sense: Apprehension/self-apprehension; gathering of experience into unified awareness
senses.warning: related to but not always interchangeable with vimarśa

senses.sense: Manifest luminosity; awareness as that in virtue of which things appear
senses.warning: 'light' is metaphorically suggestive but can mislead if treated as physical

senses.sense: Emission, release, manifestation; power by which the supreme projects itself
senses.translation_policy: 'emission' as safest literal anchor; tag context separately
senses.warning: carries phonemic, cosmological, and some erotic/ritual resonances; tag sub-senses (grammatical/cosmogonic/Kaula/breath/ritual/erotic)

senses.sense: The unsurpassed/ultimate; concentrated Parā/Ekavīrā and supreme state
senses.warning: not merely the adjective 'highest'; a highly loaded technical term

senses.sense: Goddess/power of 'sky/space'; mantra-body, Mālinī, structured divine body
senses.warning: not reducible to later Haṭhayogic tongue gesture

senses.sense: mudrā, internal condition/power, movement through space, creation/retraction, possession
senses.warning: excellent test case for polysemy within one chapter

senses.sense: Conscious awareness considered in dynamic sequence (saṃvitkrama)
senses.warning: essential for why ritual order can model cognition

senses.sense: Inherent autonomy/freedom of conscious agency (ontological efficacy + volition)
senses.warning: this is ontological efficacy as well as volition

senses.sense: Goddess/phonemic arrangement/power of mantra-language
senses.translation_policy: keep deity, alphabet, mantra ontology connected
senses.warning: keep deity, alphabet, mantra connected

senses.sense: Mother/phonemic matrix; power embodied in letters
senses.warning: candidate for cross-text phonemic dossier

senses.sense: Retraction, withdrawal, dissolution
senses.warning: context ranges from cosmic process to ritual/internalized operation

senses.sense: Recognition of one's identity/nature as the autonomous conscious principle
senses.warning: do not treat 'recognition' as mere recollection
